evidence.locator: Deposited author manuscript: Results; Figs. 2–5, 7–8; Extended Data Figs. 2–10; Methods S27–S35

This manuscript is not authenticated as publisher-final parity; figures/supplement bodies and exact case expansion remain unresolved.

evidence.locator: Fig. 3b, Fig. 4b; Methods: Choice/context decoding from neural population or kinematic features
evidence.supports: Four accuracy time courses plus matched shuffled-label controls; ridge-logistic fourfold selection with 30% outer test trials in the manuscript, distinct from released SVM training-pool CV.

evidence.locator: Fig. 3d,f,i; Fig. 4c,d; Methods: Predicting projections along coding directions from kinematic features
evidence.supports: Choice/ramp/context predictions, original coefficient contributions and randomized-delay prediction control; manuscript specifies signed 1-SSE/SST, 5-ms/six-bin history, 40% choice/ramp test trials and 30% context test trials.

evidence.locator: Fig. 3h; Methods: Emergence of CDchoice selectivity/motion energy in randomized vs. fixed delay tasks
evidence.supports: Choice selectivity and motion-energy onset panels for fixed and randomized tasks use first strict 90%-of-pre-go-maximum crossing relative to delay onset; randomized displayed target is 1.2-s trials.

evidence.locator: Fig. 5; Methods: Subspace identification (trial-averaged data), Subspace identification (single-trial data)
evidence.supports: Orthogonal stationary/moving subspaces, covariance/eigenvalue normalized variance, reconstruction and single-unit signed VE/alignment are distinct quantities; single-trial total variance contributions are reported separately.

evidence.locator: Extended Data Figs. 4–8; Fig. 5g,n; Methods: Subspace identification (single-trial data)
evidence.supports: WC-only, response-only, two-stage-PCA, dimensionality 4/6/8/13, covariance-biased random-subspace alignment, correct/error-trial and within-subspace direction controls accompany decomposition.
Choice selectivity exists in null and potent components; their correct/error and sample-to-delay trajectories differ. Ramping is largely potent; movement coupling and unit alignments remain required.

evidence.locator: Fig. 8; Extended Data Fig. 9; Methods: CDcontext selectivity on High move and Low move trials
evidence.supports: Context in both subspaces, high/low-motion contrasts and block-wise persistence; omit last 40 trials for this analysis and preserve DR/WC, full/null/potent, adjacent block and movement masks.

evidence.locator: Extended Data Fig. 10; Results: Tongue kinematics encoded in the movement-potent subspace
evidence.supports: Correct/error action projections and tongue-angle prediction from full/null/potent activity accompany separation of motor from internal dynamics; these are not replaced by a single classifier score.

target.description: Separate ALM movement-related and internal dynamics in delayed-response/water-cued tasks, including choice/context readouts and movement-related neural predictions; descriptive subspace alignment and onset effects are not themselves maximization targets.

dataset.description: Author Zenodo 13941415 v1 contains electrophysiology, keypoints and motion energy in separate fixed-delay, randomized-delay and inhibition folders.

cohort.description: Exact final-paper animal/session joins remain open: the existing audit records 25/9 paper versus 25/10 source fixed-delay sessions/animals, and 12/6 versus 12/7 two-context support. These registration observations require primary-source adjudication.

split.description: Final-paper test support and code cross-validation dispatch must be reconciled; the prospective animal-held-out protocol is not the original result.

inputs.description: Full session neural activity plus measured keypoint/motion signals and condition labels are identified. Candidate visibility of historical movement thresholds and fitted ranks remains unadmitted.

preprocessing.description: Time grid, lag construction, trial resets, baseline subtraction, smoothing, rank fitting and movement-threshold origin require an authoritative final-paper/code mapping.

metric.description: Movement-prediction corr-squared, signed 1-SSE/SST reconstruction VE, and binary decoding accuracy are distinct. No generic R2 label or prospective metric substitution is admitted.

aggregation.description: Retain session, animal, representation and time-panel identities and every original eligible case; no heterogeneous aggregate or favorable-case renormalization has source authority.

full_panel.description: Retain all sixteen registered obligation groups: subspaces/projectors; normalized null and potent variance; population reconstruction; DR/WC choice and context projections; choice/context crossed with neural/kinematic decoding; movement-to-choice and movement-to-ramp prediction; fixed/randomized crossed with choice/motion onsets. Retain original shuffled-label, trial-average delay/response, WC-only, response-only, two-stage-PCA, dimensionality 4/6/8/13, covariance-biased random-alignment, correct/error, context high/low-movement, context prediction, randomized 1.2-s fit-exclusion, CDchoice ROC, kinematic-coefficient and action/tongue companions. Final ordered mouse/session/probe/unit/trial/condition/time/rank case matrix and complete reference vectors are not authenticated; source-level finding declarations below cannot substitute for that matrix. The findings list represents only actual published scalar/categorical summaries. Required variance matrices, reconstructed activity, neural/kinematic accuracy and shuffled-control time courses, per-session prediction vectors, motion-onset traces, alignment distributions, ROC curves, coefficient panels and action/tongue outputs remain unrepresented structured outputs in v1; no null scalar or categorical match stands in for them. Full-panel computational reproduction cannot be admitted from this partial contract.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions must receive identical original paper, ALM neural observations, measured keypoint/motion observations, condition/trial identities and permitted training/development support; only the selected official author-code manifest may be added in paper_data_author_code. Saved reference predictions and evaluator targets are not candidate inputs. Historical rank-table and saved motion-threshold access are data-derived privileges requiring explicit common admission, not automatic author-code additions. No new animal-held-out split, altered lag/reset rule, source repair, clock, reduced session panel or historical target exposure is silently relabeled original reproduction. Exact authentic delivery, exposure, fit/score support and resource/access manifests remain absent.

All sixteen obligations and listed companions require a complete ordered authentic case matrix, source granular reference outputs and exact condition/trial/time/rank expansions. These source-level findings do not themselves instantiate every panel cell.
The local PMC body is a deposited author manuscript, not authenticated publisher-final parity; linked figure artwork, formula images and supplementary bodies are not supplied by the narrative cache.

Movement-prediction manuscript signed 1-SSE/SST, released delay-trial-mean corr-squared, 5-ms versus10-ms histories, target/support cropping and decoder ridge-logistic outer-test versus SVM training-pool CV identities remain unresolved.

Native source dispatch, reversed coding-direction arguments, missing required responseOnly/ta_projectNP behavior, context even-switch branch, rank/threshold provenance and any selected repair require explicit original-source adjudication.

Normalized covariance variance needs exact covariance, basis and denominator rank/support; the accepted artifact evaluator explicitly does not compute these two groups. Total-variance percentages and reconstruction signed VE cannot replace them.

The accepted evaluate_submissions interface consumes authenticated prediction bytes plus independently supplied operator row/target/time operands; it does not construct authentic operands, execute candidate analysis, fit/source-verify models or verify bases/reconstructions/coefficient/trace derivation.

Original shuffled-label realizations, random-alignment distributions, WC-only/response-only/two-stage/rank controls, high/low movement masks and randomized fit/project groups need source-native derivation verification; published aggregate matching alone is insufficient.

No justified numeric tolerances, independently adjudicated mouse-level reproduction uncertainty, complete reference vectors or minimum replication counts are frozen. Published SD/SEM, p-values and generated-control precision are not acceptance rules.
